test-set.name: visit-each
test-set.description: visit-each: the items a rule's assertions are evaluated for.

test-case.name: visit-each-nodes
test-case.description: Each node visit-each selects becomes the context of the assertions.

test-case.name: visit-each-empty-fires
test-case.description: When visit-each selects nothing, the rule still fires: no assertion is evaluated, its flag is raised, and a later rule in the pattern does not fire for the node.

test-case.name: visit-each-atomic
test-case.description: visit-each may select atomic values; the assertions see each as the context item. (The location of such a finding is not compared.)

finding.message: Code "DE" is not three characters long.
Code "IJKL" is not three characters long.

test-case.name: visit-each-variables
test-case.description: visit-each with a variable of the schema.

test-case.name: visit-each-syntax
test-case.description: A visit-each that is not an expression of the query language.

test-case.name: visit-each-on-abstract-rule
test-case.description: visit-each belongs to a rule with a context; an abstract rule has none.
